1) the asthma control questionnaire (ACQ) is the most appropriate tool for measuring asthma control in clinical research, but it is not appropriate for primary care; 2) the Asthma Control Test (ACT) and Asthma Control Test-UK are appropriate for measuring asthma control both in clinical research and in primary care; and 3) the Asthma Therapy Assessment Questionnaire is not recommended for measuring asthma control, either in clinical research or in primary care.
